name: game-night
description: Game Night Full-Stack: frontend/ (React + Vite) และ backend/ (Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
